messages.subject: Positing text and stuff
parts:
Newbie here....

I've stumbled through a project that displays set of images that can be animated with sliders. So basically what Ive got is an array of 5 movies that can be scanned through. Now I want to label them and I'm stuck. I'd rather not "print" labels on the original images (they are preexisting and number in the tens of thousands). I just want to line up some text with each image panel, but the text seems to go wherever it wants. I've looked into div, and span, and fluid page, and it's all over my head. Seems like there ought to be a simple way to attach a label to an object. In leu of that, I'd like to find some resources about how to control the position of text and output objects (decent documentation of span fluid page, etc.).

This code stacks the images and labels on top of each other and extends down so that you can only see a couple of images at once. I'd like to arrange them in rows so that they will all be viewable simultaneously on a small screen.

Enter code here...  
mainPanel(
      (p("sequence 1",inline = T),
      imageOutput("myImage1",inline = T),
      (p("sequence 2",inline = T),
      imageOutput("myImage2",inline = T),
      p("sequence 3",inline = T),
      imageOutput("myImage3",inline = T),
      p("sequence 4",inline = T),
      imageOutput("myImage4",inline = T),
      p("sequence 5",inline = T),
      imageOutput("myImage5",inline = T)
  )

For a similar problem I used a table. In server.R

output$imagePlot <-renderText({
  paste0('<table width="100%"><tr align="center"><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(1,1),
         '"></td><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(1,2),
         '"></td><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(1,3),
         '"></td></tr><tr align="center"><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(2,1),
         '"></td><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(2,2),
         '"></td><td width="33%"><img src="',
         image(2,3),
         '"></td></tr></table>')
})

with the image(x,y) delivers the name of the image and the images located in the www subdirectory. And in ui.R

mainPanel(
  plotOutput("distPlot"),
  htmlOutput('imagePlot')
)),

Best Sigbert
